A rule limits the total number of thermal unit start-ups to be no more than the total number of hydro unit start-ups.
The objective is to minimize the original cost, while ensuring the number of thermal units started is less than or equal to the number of hydro unit start-ups.
The number of thermal units running in period 18-24 is limited to 50% of the number in period 09-15.
The number of thermal units running in period 18-24 is limited to 50% of those in period 09-15.
